description: Live eBay US Buy It Now listings of an item priced under what the same item actually sells for. Use when the user wants to buy something below market. One search runs, as in get_sold_comps (the query as typed, model or part_number appended when missing; with no query, brand plus model or part number): the recent sold prices give the usual price (soldBaseline: typicalPrice, the range and how many sales), then the live listings for the same words are checked title by title and only the same item is kept (other models, lots and accessories are left out, and for-parts listings unless condition asks for them). A deal's total is price plus shipping when eBay gives shipping; it is at least 15% under the usual price for its condition, or, with max_price, at or under max_price (shipping shown) and at least 5% under the usual price. Up to 10 deals, best discount first, each with title, price, shipping, condition, seller feedback, how far under (say) and the listing link. Prices in USD. When deals carry links, disclosure is a sentence the user must see.

brand.description: The brand or maker exactly as printed on the item, its tag or its label (for example "Simrad", "Pyrex", "Levi's"). Fill it from what you read on the item or the user's photo; leave it empty rather than guess.

condition.description: Only listings in this condition, measured against sales in the same condition. Leave empty for new and used; for-parts listings are shown only when this asks for them.

max_price.description: The most the user wants to pay in USD, shipping included when eBay shows it. With it, a listing qualifies at or under this price with its shipping shown and at least 5% under the usual price; without it, at least 15% under the usual price.

model.description: The model or product-line name as printed on the item or its box (for example "iPhone 12", "QuietComfort 35", "Odyssey G5", "501"). It is passed to the identification as a hint and added to the search when no word of it is already there; it never replaces the search. Put a manufacturer part number in part_number. Leave it empty rather than guess.

part_number.description: The manufacturer part number printed on the label or rating plate (for example "000-16294-001", "DCD771C2", "CUH-ZCT2U"), copied character for character. Not a size, voltage, year, SKU, ASIN, LPN or barcode. In price_item it is a hint to the identification only and is not added to the search (a part number required in every listing title leaves too few sales); in get_sold_comps it is appended to the query when the query lacks it. Leave it empty rather than guess.

query.description: 3 to 6 specific words, brand and model first, like an eBay search.

name: find_underpriced

deals.description: Live listings priced under the usual sale price.

soldBaseline.description: What the item usually sells for.

cite.description: A sentence to show the user, naming where the price came from.

title: Find eBay listings under market
